name: chat-room
description: A local command line for durable human questions, agent-only chatter, CLI chats, and conflict detection.

interface.shortDescription: A local chat room for humans, agents, and Git worktrees.
interface.longDescription: Gives every Git project a local command line shared by humans, Codex sessions, Claude Code sessions, subagents, and linked worktrees. It keeps human-in-the-loop questions durable, groups repeated conflicts into agent-only chatter, mirrors local CLI transcripts, safely continues supported sessions with local images, and can start an explicitly tagged idle Codex turn.
defaultPrompt: List open coordination threads and path overlaps.
